contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ PLAVTILLA AVGVS[TA] ; R/ CONCORDIA AVGG

Silver coin. Denarius of Plautilla (202-205), Sear volume 2 page 548 no. 7065, citing RIC volume 4 part 1 no. 363, mint of Rome issue of 202. Obverse description: Bust draped and coiffed right. Obverse inscription: PLAVTILLA AVGVS[TA]. Reverse description: Concordia standing left holding patera and sceptre. Reverse inscription: CONCORDIA AVGG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.6mm, Weight: 3.17gms, die axis: 6
